title: stack-target-v1
description: A tech-stack descriptor for KCF LLM code generation. Declares the target technologies and conventions so the code-generation prompt is stack-specific and reproducible. Ship one per shipped example under stacks/<id>/stack.json; users can author their own to target any stack.

tier.description: Which tier this stack generates. backend = persistence + action contract + OpenAPI/Swagger; frontend = UI generated against a backend's OpenAPI; platform = customizations for a SaaS/low-code platform (e.g. NetSuite, Salesforce) — the platform owns the datastore, runtime, and UI, and the pack emits platform-native objects/scripts packaged for its deployment framework (no OpenAPI mandate).

language.description: Primary language, e.g. Python, TypeScript, SuiteScript 2.1

framework.description: Web/app/UI framework or platform SDK, e.g. FastAPI, Express, Django + DRF, React, SuiteCloud SDF

orm.description: Data-access layer (backend), e.g. SQLModel, Prisma, Django ORM. For a platform: the record/data API, e.g. SuiteScript N/record + N/search.

database.description: Datastore (backend), e.g. PostgreSQL. For a platform: its native record store, e.g. 'NetSuite records (native)'.

apiDocs.description: Backend: how the OpenAPI/Swagger interface is exposed (tool + path), e.g. 'FastAPI built-in /docs', 'drf-spectacular /api/docs', 'swagger-ui-express /docs'. Frontend: the OpenAPI client generator, e.g. 'openapi-typescript + openapi-fetch'. Platform: how the programmatic surface is exposed, e.g. 'RESTlet endpoints (SuiteScript); no native OpenAPI'.

deployment.description: Platform tier: how the emitted customization project is packaged and deployed, e.g. 'SuiteCloud SDF project deployed with `suitecloud project:deploy`'.

conventions.description: Short, imperative conventions the generator must follow (naming, layering, migration tool, how optimistic concurrency / authorization are expressed in this stack).

example.description: Relative path to the single-shot EXAMPLE.md the LLM imitates.
